BCCI Considers Player Rest in Future Cricket Scheduling

The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) is reportedly considering a more player-friendly future tour program (FTP) to allow for adequate rest and acclimatization. This review is prompted by India's recent struggles in overseas series, particularly in "SENA" (South Africa, England, New Zealand, Australia) nations. The aim is to improve player well-being and performance by reducing excessive travel and matches, potentially leading to better preparation for challenging international tours.
